author: Cptnwhizbang
body: Work on strategies for deep endless dungeons. One of the easiest and most efficient is using summoner, so aim to unlock both celestial classes. otherwise, deity ara also does super well in endless.

author: dfoley323
body:
I would strongly advise you work on getting seed husk it is a top tier pet and goes away at the end of the week.

In general i would focus on towers/raids to level up.  Its not fast but it doesnt need to be.  Once you are t10 the goal is to collect gear/pets.  

If you absolutely need exp your best bet is to party with someone doing deep endless runs and you get a cut of the exp.

author: frosmayn
body: Grand summoner using Ancient Jinn summon. Stack as much +exp gear you have and pop exp shrines, etc. Then run monuments, just targeting bosses.
